evidence: The devices in this study were made on 200-mm p-type⟨100⟩ Si substrates with shallow trench isolation (STI). Prior to HfO2 deposition, the wafers were cleaned and etched in a diluted HF followed by the interfacial-layer formation consisting either of a 0.4-nm (Imec04) or 1-nm (Imec clean)-thick chemical oxide, or a 1–3-nm slant-etched SiO2.
